intentAndPurpose.intent: Circular single-text action button (max 2 characters, e.g. "Ag", "En"). Attention level drives the visual: high=bold fill, medium=subtle fill, low=ghost. 3 sizes (S/M/L). Shape customisable per brand.

props.name: children
props.description: Text label content — max 2 characters (e.g. "Ag", "En", "A", "12"). This component renders as a circular button; longer text breaks the shape. Text exceeding 2 characters will be truncated in development with a warning.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent appearance role. 'auto' resolves to 'primary'. Default: 'auto'.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for screen readers (optional — children text is visible).

props.name: attention
props.description: Attention level — drives the visual variant. high → bold fill (solid accent bg, on-bold-high text) medium → subtle fill (tinted bg, accent text) low → ghost (transparent bg, accent text) Default: 'high'.

props.name: condensed
props.description: Condensed mode: shrinks the circular hit box and steps typography down one Label rung (S→XS, M→S, L→M). Spinner size stays tied to `size`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill container width — overrides circular shape.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading state — shows circular progress indicator replacing the text label. Disables interaction while loading.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size. Default: 'm'. S/M/L only (no XS).

interactionBehavior.summary: SingleTextButton is an action button, not a toggle — there is no selected state. It scales UP on press (`--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up`, 7%), the opposite direction to Button's squash and the same as IconButton, while the fill steps to a hover/pressed token for the resolved attention level. `loading` implies disabled and REPLACES the 1–2 character label with a spinner (the letters leave the tree). `type` defaults to `"button"`, unlike Button and LinkButton which inherit native `submit`.
hover: The fill steps to the hover token for the resolved attention level: `--{Role}-Bold-Hover` at `attention="high"`, `--{Role}-Subtle-Hover` at `medium`, `--{Role}-Hover` at `low`.
Only the background changes; the label colour stays put.
A brand material (gradient) fill at `attention="high"` keeps `--{Role}-Material-Fill` on hover, because swapping a flat colour over a gradient reads as a glitch.
Wrapped in `@media (hover: hover)` and qualified with `:not([data-disabled])`, so a touch tap never leaves a stuck fill and disabled/loading never hover.
press: The fill deepens to `--{Role}-Bold-Pressed`, `--{Role}-Subtle-Pressed`, or `--{Role}-Pressed` by attention level. High-attention material fills stay on `--{Role}-Material-Fill`.

The whole button scales UP: `scale(calc(1 + var(--_tap-direction) * var(--_tap-scale) / 100))` with `--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up` at 7% and `--_tap-direction: 1`. Button scales DOWN; this matches IconButton instead.
`fullWidth` does NOT reduce the tap-scale — unlike Button, there is no `--Motion-Tap-Scale-FullWidth` remap, so a stretched circular-turned-pill still grows 7%.
Press is NOT `(hover: hover)`-guarded, so a finger tap gets the fill and the scale-up.
focus: Keyboard focus draws the two-layer halo: an inner `--Stroke-XL` gap ring in `--Surface-Halo-Gap` plus an outer `--Focus-Outline` ring, so it survives a tinted `<Surface>`.
`:focus` alone only clears the native outline; the visible ring is `:focus-visible`, so a mouse click does not paint it.
keyboard: Renders a native `<button>`, so `Enter` and `Space` both activate it — `Enter` is covered by a unit test.
`type` defaults to `"button"` (`type={typeProp ?? 'button'}`), so it will not submit an enclosing form unless you pass `type="submit"`.
Disabled and loading buttons are removed from the tab order because the native `disabled` attribute is applied.
loading: `loading` implies disabled — `isDisabled = disabled || loading` — so the native `disabled` attribute is set and `onClick` / `onPress` stop firing.
The label is REPLACED in the tree by a `CircularProgressIndicator` (ternary, not `opacity: 0`), so the accessible name falls back to `aria-label` if you passed one — the letters themselves are gone.
The spinner stroke is forced to `currentColor` and the track is transparent, so on `attention="high"` the arc stays readable against `--{Role}-Bold` instead of painting the same purple-on-purple.
The whole button dims to `--Loading-Opacity` and takes `pointer-events: none`.
disabled: Dims to `--Disabled-Opacity` and sets `cursor: not-allowed` plus `pointer-events: none` on both `[data-disabled]` and `:disabled`.

Because the element is natively `disabled` AND has `pointer-events: none`, the `not-allowed` cursor is not observable — the pointer shows the parent's cursor. Known, accepted system-wide gap (see docs/design/disabled-states.md).
Hover and press fills, and the tap-scale, are all qualified with `:not([data-disabled])`.
touch: Hover fills never apply on touch-only devices; the pressed fill plus the 7% scale-up are the entire response to a tap.
Growing on press is the right direction for a control this small — the circle expands out from under the fingertip that is covering the letters.
